title: Static strength margin
description: Requires a stress study on the part and a minimum safety factor against yield. Needs a `study` op and a mechanical material (op set_material).

study.description: Id of the study op; "*" = the only stress study.

min_safety_factor.description: Yield strength / maximum von Mises stress.

rules.citation: Guideline: general engineering practice, safety factor of at least 1.5 against yield for ductile materials under static load; the code governing your application takes precedence
rules.note: DUCAD's linear FEA is an engineering estimate (about +/-10 % on the default mesh).
